extracted.intended_audience: researchers registering or conducting PRISMA-S style systematic reviews (especially review-of-reviews) and OSF/ preregistration users
extracted.subtask_description: A pre-registration record describing a PRISMA-S style systematic search of review articles (a review-of-reviews) for sensors, platforms, and networks. The record documents planned methods, metadata (DOI, subjects, license), and notes that this particular registration is single-researcher and has been withdrawn for correction.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-S style search (systematic)
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a pre-registration for a PRISMA-S style search of review articles. This search will be conducted in a systematic manner, but it does not meet the criteria for other PRISMA outlined searches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied to review articles / review-of-reviews; indicates intention to follow PRISMA-S reporting/search documentation standards rather than other PRISMA variants. No checklist items are enumerated on this page; the record asserts systematic search methods will be used under the PRISMA-S approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-researcher search; no confirmation of results
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a single-researcher search, no confirmation of results will be conducted by researchers in this group for this particular method.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit limitation: screening, data extraction, or search-result confirmation will not be independently replicated or confirmed by additional team members for this method. This bears on reproducibility and risk of single-reviewer bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-registration metadata and licensing (DOI, subjects, license, correction/withdrawal policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Osf_registration_doi 10.17605/OSF.IO/TJ6EP; License https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode. Note this registration has been withdrawn: This is an outdated registration which will be removed to allow for a correction in the name. The new title is: "Sensors, Platforms, and Networks Survey - PRISMA-S Review of Reviews". The withdrawal will leave these metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-registrations should include clear metadata (DOI, subjects, project link) and an explicit license. If metadata or methods contain errors, records may be withdrawn/updated and replacement registrations posted; the page documents this corrective process.
